summary: If job templates are missing from the portal: check surveyEnabled matches the templates, check the labels filter names, remove filters temporarily, verify the case-sensitive organization name, and check AAP connectivity and token permissions.
questions: Job templates not showing in self-service automation portal
Why are my AAP job templates missing from the portal?
Is the portal organization name case-sensitive?

answer_card.title: Job templates missing from the portal
answer_card.answer_md:
1. Check `surveyEnabled` in the Helm values matches your job templates' survey status.
2. Check the `labels` filter uses the right AAP label names.
3. Temporarily remove filters to see if templates appear.
4. Verify the AAP organization name exactly (case-sensitive).
5. Check AAP connectivity and the token's permissions.
